summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it, marks it executable, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a sibling file shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle that is heavily obfuscated (shuffled string-array rotator `WV8StW(MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()))`, hex-named identifiers, large embedded constants table). It is not referenced by the package's declared `main` (`dist/index.js`) or by any advertised ESLint-plugin functionality; the only path that reaches it is the preinstall dropper. The alternate-runtime execution (Bun rather than Node) prevents Node-based tooling from tracing the payload's behavior. The advertised purpose of the package is an ESLint plugin, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and run an obfuscated bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
